# Brain Harness — Autonomous Agent Micro-Kernel Documentation

> Brain Harness is a modular autonomous AI agent execution environment and micro-kernel where everything is a plugin.

## Core Architectural Invariants
- Everything is a Plugin: Capabilities register into the IoC container. No domain tools are hardcoded in kernel.
- Typed Service Keys: Services use ServiceKey[T] (`context.require(KEY)`). Never raw strings.
- Transactional Isolation: Step executions execute in context transactions with automated Git rollback on failure.
- Immutable Events: The EventBus log is append-only and strictly immutable.
- Sandboxing: Untrusted external plugins run in subprocess sandboxes with lazy venv staging and proactor pipe disposal.

- [CLI Reference](reference/cli.md): Click CLI commands, options, and usage examples.
- [Plugin Manifest](reference/plugin-manifest.md): plugin.json schema, lifecycle states, and zero-fork configuration.
